decision_contract: Proceed with the two-write lane-log architecture only when put_then_conditional_update p95 is below 160 ms. A p95 at or above 200 ms disproves the sub-200 ms scalar acknowledgement gate for a two-dependent-write S3 durability boundary on this host/region. Values from 160 ms through below 200 ms are inconclusive and require a second isolated qualification before architecture selection.
